ModMetaData.name: Armors For All Post-Medieval Tech Levels
ModMetaData.author: Bambaryla, Pesky, KylarZ, Samael Gray
ModMetaData.description:
A comprehensive armor suite adding 7 armor sets across 3 tiers of technology:
• Armored Suits (Tech Level: Industrial) - Light, Combat and Heavy-duty suits • Advanced Spacer (Tech Level: Spacer) - Flanker, Vanguard and Breacher armors with enhanced protection over vanilla. • Glitter (Tech Level: Ultra) - Top-tier armor that can only be found or received as a reward
Includes matching helmets for each armor variant. Full Combat Extended compatibility. Includes researches for each armor.
Armored Suits are crafted at the Machining Table, Advanced Spacer armors at the Fabrication Bench.
Credits: * Komandor Bambaryła - Design * KylarZ - Testing and design breakdowns * Pesky - All Armor and Helmet Textures * Samael Gray - XML definitions and CE patching
* Inspirations: - Light Suit is based on a light armor from the game "Menace" by Overhype Studios - go check it out: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2432860/MENACE/ - Combat Suit is based on the base armor from the game Helldivers 2 by Arrowhead Studios - https://store.steampowered.com/app/553850/HELLDIVERS_2/ - Heavy Suit is based on a design from the movie Starship Troopers: Annihilation - Flanker Armor is based on the armor from the Halo franchise - Vanguard Armor is based on another armor from the Halo franchise - Breacher Armor is based on the designs from the GloryHammer music video Die With a Sword In My Hand - https://youtu.be/l7FdL1LArWo - Ultra is an original design by Pesky - The armor abilities are inspired by A RimWorld of Magic by Torann and JecsTools by jecrell
